_about: External reference for the chart file's 12-month slow-planet ingresses (reshape B4). Copied verbatim from DrikPanchang's planet-transit pages for New Delhi (geoname-id 1261481, Asia/Kolkata), fetched 2026-10-19: /planet/transit/{guru,shani,rahu}-transit-date-time.html?geoname-id=1261481&year={2026,2027}. Times are IST as printed (minute precision). drik_retro_mark = DrikPanchang printed its retrograde mark (U+21BA) on the row; it never prints one for the nodes, which always move backward. DrikPanchang lists the MEAN Rahu (it prints 'True Rahu' separately: 2026-11-25 16:34). Its Lahiri is neither of the engine's two flavours: the six Jupiter/Saturn events lie BETWEEN the engine's plain-lahiri and lahiri_vp285 instants (up to ~50 min from vp285); the slow mean node's lies 10 min (~1.3") past vp285. The test asserts, in ARC: at each printed minute the engine's vp285 longitude is within 40" of the boundary; plus identical bodies, signs, order and IST dates.
